correctness.rationale: For markers i<j, their left and right admissible incidences give X,Y and the pair spacing bit h; subtract the possible 11 pair once from each of the mixed counts, giving (T−X−Y+h,X−h,Y−h,h). This is invertible to the signature (X+Y−2t,h,X), where t=n−2s+1. In the middle zone, exact separation e gives coordinate sums e,e+2,…,2t−e. For s≥3 these yield 2t−1 short-pair sums (from e=1,2) and 2t−2s+1 long-pair sums (from e=s,s+1, or just e=s if t=s). At fixed positive excess δ≤s−1, the left–middle, left–right and middle–right ranges are disjoint and fill [0,2t+δ]. The spacing bit may vary within a range, but each X specifies one primary pair; the same-side repetitions at the extremes agree in h=0 because at the extremes the primary pair's gap is δ<s. For δ≥s, left–right contributes s(s−1)/2 profiles in all and the two same-side extremes add 2(s−2); the latter are possible precisely for s≤δ≤2s−3 (choose one excess s−1 and the other δ−s+1). This gives (2s+2)t+s²−5. At t=s−1 the positive excess arguments still apply and the zero-excess slice has no long pairs, replacing the formal count −1 by zero. For s=2, t≥2, the zero slice has t odd short sums plus 2t−3 long sums; the positive slices give 2t+2 and 1. At t=1 there is one short and no long zero-excess profile and the positive slices are unchanged, giving six. A maximum code has one representative per deck. A separate literal four-count enumeration for 2≤s≤10 and s≤n≤3s+4 covered 153 parameter pairs and 21,549 marker pairs. It agreed where the theorem or boundary asserts a value, e.g. C₃(8)=28 and C₃(7)=21.
